tools.name: agentic.readiness_probe
tools.description: Free multi-surface storefront readiness snapshot (UCP/ACP discovery, product schema, robots, answer-engine maps). Not an attested Store Guard grade. Response includes a Store Guard $149 CTA. No API key required.

tools.name: dispatch.quote
tools.description: Request a field-service quote by trade, location, and urgency. Returns availability and quote details when available. Accepts a provisioned integration key through x-api-key or, when OAuth is enabled, a scoped self-serve OAuth token through Authorization: Bearer. MCP also accepts the provisioned key

tools.name: dispatch.estimate
tools.description: Public modeled field-service price estimate with cited BLS wage benchmarks. Returns customer hourly rates, line items, ranges and a total alongside geographic scope and source provenance. Model estimates are not observed transaction prices or binding quotes. Use dispatch.quote with an accepted crede

tools.name: dispatch.order
tools.description: Create a field-service order and return its status URL. HTTP 201 returns a created order; HTTP 202 returns an order accepted_pending_fulfilment with fulfilled=false. Order creation requires a provisioned integration key through x-api-key. MCP also accepts that key through Authorization: Bearer; dire

tools.name: dispatch.evals
tools.description: Return the public evaluation document for a selected rolling window. Consult its per-field provenance and methodology to distinguish self-reported estimates, measurements, and unavailable fields. It is not an independent audit or a service-level guarantee. No API key required.

tools.name: dispatch.index
tools.description: Return the catalog of 8 dispatch trade verticals. Per trade: the BLS OES hourly WAGE benchmark (medianRateDollars/p25/p75 — what a technician earns, NOT a price) alongside billedHourlyRateRoutineDollars, a modeled customer hourly estimate at routine urgency. Estimates are not observed transaction pr

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "dispatch.quote" references sensitive artifacts (auth token, authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
